property.caption: Email List Data
property.description: List of emails to display

property.caption: Subject
property.description: Email subject

property.caption: Sender
property.description: Sender name or email

property.caption: Date
property.description: Date received/sent

property.caption: Body Snippet
property.description: A short preview of the email body

property.caption: Body Content (Plain/HTML)
property.description: The full content of the email

property.caption: Is Read
property.description: Boolean indicating if the email has been read

property.caption: Group Category
property.description: String like 'Today', 'Yesterday', 'Last Week'

property.caption: To
property.description: Recipient(s) of the email

property.caption: Cc
property.description: CC recipients of the email

property.caption: Folder
property.description: Email folder: 'Inbox', 'Drafts', or 'Sent'

property.caption: Draft To
property.description: Attribute to store the To field (e.g. comma separated)

property.caption: Draft Cc
property.description: Attribute to store the Cc field

property.caption: Draft Subject
property.description: Attribute to store the subject input

property.caption: Draft Body
property.description: Attribute to store the email body (Rich Text/HTML)

property.caption: Partner List
property.description: Partner objects from microflow

property.caption: Partner Caption
property.description: Caption shown in partner dropdown

property.caption: On Partner Change
property.description: Microflow called when partner is checked/unchecked — toggles helper ↔ partner association

property.caption: Selected Partner List
property.description: Partners currently associated with the helper (used to show checkmarks in popup)

property.caption: Selected Partner Caption
property.description: Caption for selected partners

property.caption: Partner Recipient List
property.description: Recipients filtered by Mendix based on selected partners

property.caption: Partner Recipient Caption
property.description: Email shown in partner recipient dropdown

property.caption: KHDA Recipient List
property.description: KHDA recipients from microflow

property.caption: KHDA Recipient Caption
property.description: Email shown in KHDA recipient dropdown

property.caption: On KHDA Change
property.description: Microflow to toggle helper ↔ KHDA recipient association

property.caption: Selected KHDA List
property.description: KHDA recipients currently associated with the helper

property.caption: Selected KHDA Caption
property.description: Caption for selected KHDA recipients

property.caption: Selected Recipient List
property.description: Created recipient objects shown as tokens in To field

property.caption: Selected Recipient Caption
property.description: Token label for selected recipient

property.caption: On Remove Recipient
property.description: Microflow to delete a selected recipient object

property.caption: On Confirm Recipients
property.description: Microflow triggered on OK — reads draft attributes and creates recipient objects

property.caption: Draft External Emails
property.description: Widget writes comma-separated external emails here before OK

property.caption: Draft Selected Recipient IDs
property.description: Widget writes comma-separated IDs of selected partner recipients + KHDA items here before OK

property.caption: CC Partner List
property.description: Partner objects for CC popup

property.caption: CC Partner Caption
property.description: Caption shown in CC partner dropdown

property.caption: On CC Partner Change
property.description: Microflow called when CC partner is checked/unchecked — toggles helper ↔ CC partner association

property.caption: CC Selected Partner List
property.description: Partners currently associated with the helper for CC

property.caption: CC Selected Partner Caption
property.description: Caption for selected CC partners

property.caption: CC Partner Recipient List
property.description: Recipients filtered by Mendix based on selected CC partners

property.caption: CC Partner Recipient Caption
property.description: Email shown in CC partner recipient list

property.caption: CC Partner Recipient Subtitle
property.description: Subtitle like 'Primary Contact' shown below email

property.caption: CC Selected Recipient List
property.description: Confirmed CC recipient objects shown as tokens in Cc field

property.caption: CC Selected Recipient Caption
property.description: Token label for selected CC recipient

property.caption: On Remove CC Recipient
property.description: Microflow to delete a selected CC recipient object

property.caption: On Confirm CC Recipients
property.description: Microflow triggered on Save — reads draft attributes and creates CC recipient objects

property.caption: Draft External CC Emails
property.description: Widget writes comma-separated external CC emails here before Save

property.caption: Draft Selected CC Recipient IDs
property.description: Widget writes comma-separated IDs of selected CC partner recipients here before Save

property.caption: Add Partnership Email to CC
property.description: Boolean toggled by widget — when true, partnership email is auto-included in CC

property.caption: Attachment List
property.description: List of attachment file documents for the selected email

property.caption: Attachment Name
property.description: Filename of the attachment

property.caption: Attachment Size
property.description: File size in bytes

property.caption: On Download Attachment
property.description: Action to download a single attachment

property.caption: On Download All Attachments
property.description: Action to download all attachments for the selected email

property.caption: On Attach File
property.description: Action to trigger the Email Connector's Add Attachment flow in compose view

property.caption: On Fetch Emails
property.description: Action triggered on widget load to fetch emails via IMAP (Mendix microflow)

property.caption: On Create New Email
property.description: Action triggered when user clicks Create New Email (microflow should create EmailMessage object)

property.caption: On Reply
property.description: Action to execute when user clicks reply

property.caption: On Send
property.description: Action to execute when user clicks send (microflow uses SMTP config)

property.caption: On Save Draft
property.description: Action to execute when user saves draft

property.caption: On Email Select
property.description: Action to execute when an email from the inbox list is selected (Passes selected EmailMessage)
